svg.title: Similar prefixes have no established connecting path
svg.desc: Keep the two prefixes isolated in black with no connector. A visual resemblance is the question; typography must not establish transfer, common origin or shared identity.

A visual resemblance is the question; typography must not establish transfer, common origin or shared identity.", "lettering": [ { "box": [ 0.045, 0.78, 0.91, 0.18 ] } ], "lettering_mode": "manual", "nodes": [ { "asset": "card", "box": [ 0.06775, 0.2012, 0.3913, 0.276474 ], "color": "dirty", "focus": true, "label": "ZZZ", "label_box": [ 0.06775, 0.49443, 0.3913, 0.121481 ], "label_size": 18 }, { "asset": "card", "box": [ 0.52275, 0.2012, 0.3913, 0.276474 ], "color": "shadow", "focus": true, "label": "zz", "label_box": [ 0.52275, 0.49443, 0.3913, 0.121481 ], "label_size": 18 } ], "reconstructed": false, "shot": "row", "source": "
**Frame:** Black, with the three letters `ZZZ` and, faint beneath them, the `zz` of [page 003](003.md). No arrow joins them.

**Caption:**
> THE NAMING ECHO IS IN THE RECORD. IT DOES NOT ESTABLISH CONTACT. SORT-LAST NAMING WAS ALREADY A HABIT HERE — AND IT DID NOT WORK.

**Provenance:** `documented` + `inferred` — the naming echo is real and is the project's observation; it is not evidence of shared identity, lineage, contact, or a convention passed between the two populations. That `ZZZ`-style names were an ordinary sort-last convention on this wiki weeks before the sweep is from [`zzz-backup-pattern.md`](../../research/zzz-backup-pattern.md), and it makes the echo less of a coincidence rather than more of one.

", "title": "Similar prefixes have no established connecting path" } }
